title: OpenAI to Roll Out Top AI Model Globally After Limited Preview
description: OpenAI is publicly launching its GPT-5.6 model family this week after a limited preview with 20 partners. The lineup includes Sol, tuned for biology, chemistry, and cybersecurity work; Terra, aimed at everyday use at roughly half the cost of GPT-5.5; and Luna, the company's lowest-cost tier.

title: SpaceXAI, Cursor Launch Grok 4.5 AI Model for Finance, Legal Applications
description: xAI unveiled Grok 4.5, its strongest model to date for coding, agentic tasks, and knowledge work, trained in part on coding data from Cursor following SpaceX's $60 billion acquisition of Cursor parent Anysphere. The launch pushes Grok into finance and legal workflows alongside developer tooling.

title: Government of Alberta uses Claude to find and fix cybersecurity vulnerabilities across government systems
description: Anthropic published a case study on how the Government of Alberta deployed Claude to identify and remediate cybersecurity vulnerabilities across its government IT systems, highlighting growing public-sector adoption of AI-assisted vulnerability management.

title: Automating cross-repo documentation with GitHub Agentic Workflows
description: GitHub detailed how GitHub Agentic Workflows can keep documentation in sync across multiple repositories automatically, letting teams update docs alongside code changes without manual intervention.

title: How GitHub Copilot enables zero DNS configuration for GitHub Pages
description: GitHub explained how Copilot now automates DNS configuration for GitHub Pages custom domains, removing a manual setup step that previously tripped up developers publishing sites.

title: The Making of Claude Code
description: Anthropic published the inside story of how Claude Code evolved from an internal command-line tool into the company's flagship coding agent, covering key design decisions along the way.
